description: Trigger an AI security scan on a repository in the active organization. Blocks until the scan completes (or the timeout is reached, in which case it returns a "still_running" handoff). Streams live progress events. Accepts either repositoryId or name.

maxBudgetUSD.description: Max budget per scan in USD (0.50–500).

modelTier.description: Model tier: low (cheapest), medium, high (most thorough). Server default if omitted.

name.description: Repository name or fullName to scan. Used only when repositoryId is not provided.

postAsIssue.description: If true, open the scan report as a GitHub/GitLab issue on completion.

repositoryId.description: Repository id to scan. Provide either repositoryId or name.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning a still_running handoff. Default 300.

name: trigger_security_scan
